nameStatus: Confirmed by rendered C5_04_02 outfit and the published Azure Empyrea outfit listing; not inferred only from the numeric suffix.
tool: AnimeStudioUltimate through isolated reflection host (BH3 serial load, explicit GameObject pathId filter)

animation.mapping: Exact name match only, with track paths changed to Avatar/Skeleton3D:<bone>; incompatible original outfit tracks removed. No body retarget rotation baked.
animation.newSecondaryBones: Outfit-specific skirt, ribbons and hair stay at their original rest transforms while following animated parent bones. No claim of the original game cloth simulation.
animation.defenseCompatibility: All 53 body/finger bones used by current Lighter defense mapping exist; default C5 rest transforms are numerically equivalent within recorded tolerance.

visual.atlasExplanation: Original Unity ST uses bottom-origin UV. The same FBX/Godot UV conversion as default C5 requires y=0.75. FBX preserves .25 tiling but loses left-eye offset. All four face meshes have different vertex ordering and a common ~0.02755m Y offset; after centroid alignment and geometric vertex matching, their UV differences are exactly zero. Face/eye/mouth PNG SHA256 values also match the existing default outfit.

runtimeAdaptation.physicsScope: Finite-angle spring follow, hanging correction and five animated body/leg capsules rebuilt for this outfit. Keeps all 122 native bones and original mesh inverse bind poses; only the 66 whitelisted auxiliary rotations change. Incoming authored auxiliary poses are preserved. Original cloth/collision solver not ported.
runtimeAdaptation.bodyClearanceVerification: tests/skin_victory_repair_suite.gd compares 450 native idle/run/guard/heavy/ultimate frames with and without capsules. Sampled skirt/leg overlap depth falls from 94.9712 to 9.0664; body/contact bones remain identical. This is a bone-segment check, not a proof that every cloth triangle is collision-free.
runtimeAdaptation.facialScope: Original eye/mouth textures with authored timing; native IN_Fuka_Winning trigger found, separate timing curves not yet ported.
